name: Beverly Sterling
bio:
Beverly Sterling is a seasoned PR professional with over two decades of experience shaping narratives and managing reputations. Her journey into motorsports began unexpectedly when she was assigned to handle media relations for a local racing team while working at a small marketing firm. Intrigued by the fast-paced environment and the passionate community, she quickly immersed herself in the world of motorsport. 

Beverly's approach to PR is grounded in pragmatism and a deep understanding of the sport's intricacies. She believes in building genuine relationships with journalists, sponsors, and fans alike. Her calm demeanor and strategic thinking make her an invaluable asset in navigating crises and maximizing positive media coverage. What sets Beverly apart is her ability to translate complex technical information into compelling stories that resonate with a broad audience.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, layered waves with subtle highlights
physical.description: Beverly is of average height with a warm smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down ideas.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters.
